replaces.idea: A mounted optical diffraction grating with fine parallel ruled grooves on a small lab stand, representing optical interference.
A Czochralski monocrystalline silicon boule resting in a V-block cradle, representing crystal growth and impurity doping.

new.name: Silicon Boule
new.depicts: A cylindrical violet silicon ingot with a tapered conical top and thin seed-crystal rod, resting horizontally in a dark-indigo V-block cradle.

new.name: Ruled Grating
new.depicts: A small rectangular violet glass plate with fine vertical ruled grooves, clamped upright in a dark-indigo lab pedestal.

new.name: Wafer Boat
new.depicts: A slotted dark-indigo quartz carrier rack standing on flat feet, holding four upright circular violet silicon wafers in parallel grooves.
new.focal: the row of notched wafer rims protruding from the slots

new.name: Spin Coater
new.depicts: A squat dark-indigo cylindrical vacuum chuck holding a flat violet wafer on top, with a tiny curved dispense nozzle arm mounted on the side.
new.focal: the curved dispense nozzle poised above the wafer center

rework.redesign: Redraw as a physical circular silicon wafer mounted on a dark-indigo chuck, with the crystal lattice grid and single pale-lavender point defect etched onto its surface.
Redraw with a solid body at least 6x6 px, a 1 px darkest-ink silhouette outline, and 1x1 px darkest-ink eyes so it reads as a stray EUV photon critter rather than a 5x5 speck.
